name: Pure Powdered Peanut Butter, PB2 Foods
reason: The salted 6.5 oz PB2 powder (PB2 Original) contains added sugar — L2 added sugar in a savory/staple category. Also a defatted-peanut-flour engineered isolate (P2 'tool').
justification: Added sugar floods the hepatic portal vein in a savory staple, driving de novo lipogenesis (P4); the defatting also strips the native lipid matrix, making it an engineered isolate rather than a whole-food (P2/P3).
notes: SKU-mapping ambiguity: the catalog lists 'Defatted Peanut Flour, Salt' (no sugar), but PB2's only genuinely sugar-free/salt-free product is 'PB2 Pure Peanut Powder — No Sugar OR Salt' (peanuts only). Since the catalog entry includes salt, the matching real 6.5 oz salted SKU is PB2 Original = Roasted Peanuts, Sugar, Salt → L2 disqualify. If PRANA instead intends the true 'Pure Peanut Powder' (peanuts only, no salt), it would be a clean but engineered isolate → Tier 2 ('tool'-capped). As sold in 6.5 oz with salt, it contains sugar and is disqualified.
